== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Armed And Dangerous & Krayt Dragon Howl (V)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-91-Armed_And_Dangerous_Krayt_Dragon_Howl.png]]) shows the original card (“Krayt Dragon Howl & Armed And Dangerous”); the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-armedanddangerous&kraytdragonhowl-pre.gif]]) and the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1261-93-front-master.png]]) show the new title with the original text.

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type, 2012-07-21 capture: https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html), title “Armed And Dangerous & Krayt Dragon Howl”. Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “USED: Cancel Disarmed or Stunning Leader. OR If a battle was just initiated, deploy a character weapon on your participating character from Reserve Deck (or hand); reshuffle. LOST: Use 1 Force to deploy (or retrieve) non-[Reflections 3] Obi-Wan from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If opponent just initiated a battle against non-[Reflections 3] Obi-Wan alone at a site, his forfeit cannot be reduced.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1261_93</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.

'''Renamed 11 November 2026 (Batch B41b):''' from VB6-91-Armed_And_Dangerous_Krayt_Dragon_Howl-PC-E1-cardmaker.png; the version it shows is now E2 (a forum post and its re-made sheet, and each card-list repeat, are versions of their own; Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026).
